entities.name: Elves
entities.description: A species of pointed-eared humanoids typically living in forests and close to the land; the characteristic race of green.

entities.name: Alaran Elves
entities.description: The Cylian or Canopy Elves of Alara who swear allegiance to the Anima and monitor Progenitus.

entities.name: Anima
entities.description: The high priest title of the elves of Alara, chosen from a line of female druids; currently Mayael.

entities.name: Mayael
entities.description: The current Anima of the Alaran elves.

entities.name: Progenitus
entities.description: An enormous five-headed hydra that sleeps beneath the Valley of the Ancient and is worshipped by the Alaran elves.

entities.name: Argothian Elves
entities.description: Elves who lived on the forest island of Argoth until the Sylex Blast.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: A Phyrexian lord who turned the Creeping Mold of Argoth into a plague against the elves.

entities.name: Elyssendril Lademmdrith
entities.description: The priestess of the Argothian elves, kidnapped by Yawgmoth and later a delegate to Halcyon.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: The artificer who destroyed Argoth by activating the Golgothian Sylex.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother, against whom Urza waged war over Argoth.

entities.name: Harbin
entities.description: Urza's son, helped by an Argothian elf when he found Argoth.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: The forest island of the Argothian elves, devastated by the Sylex Blast.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: The artifact Urza activated to destroy Argoth.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: The explosion that decimated Argoth.

entities.name: Fyndhorn Elves
entities.description: Survivors of the Argothian elves who engaged in diplomacy with Kjeldor and later fled to Yavimaya.

entities.name: Kaysa
entities.description: A leader who led the Fyndhorn refugees to Yavimaya.

entities.name: Jaeuhl Carthalion
entities.description: A leader who led the Fyndhorn refugees to Yavimaya.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: The forest where the Yavimayan elves live.

entities.name: Yavimayan Elves
entities.description: Elves of Yavimaya sharing thoughts with the forest, later Kavu riders cast out by Multani.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: The spirit of Yavimaya whose rage cast out the elves.

entities.name: Meria
entities.description: The leader of the Yavimayan exiles.

entities.name: Coalition
entities.description: The alliance formed against the Second Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Skyshroud Elves
entities.description: Elves transported to Rath by Phyrexians and later planeshifted to Keld with the Skyshroud forest.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A planeswalker worshipped as a goddess by Llanowar and Skyshroud elves.

entities.name: Llanowar Elves
entities.description: Xenophobic elves of the Llanowar forest who worshipped Freyalise.

entities.name: Havenwood Elves
entities.description: Sarpadian elves whose magical fungus created the thallids that drove them to extinction.

entities.name: Thallids
entities.description: Monstrous fungal creatures created by the Havenwood elves.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: An artifact whose mana waves mutated the Wirewood elves.

entities.name: Wirewood Elves
entities.description: Otarian elves mutated by the Mirari.

entities.name: Red Donald
entities.description: A foe of the black elves of Glenar who survived their poison.

entities.name: Black elves
entities.description: Elves of the Domains who lived in the forest of Glenar.

entities.name: Calthyn Elves
entities.description: A Corondor clan, enemies of the Kieryn elves.

entities.name: Kieryn Elves
entities.description: A Corondor clan using wingcapes, enemies of the Calthyn elves.

entities.name: Exarch Finovar
entities.description: A leader of the Calthyn elves.

entities.name: Exarch Amadis
entities.description: The leader of the Kieryn clan.

entities.name: Elves of Skemfar
entities.description: The Kaldheim elves, formerly the Einir gods, split into Wood and Shadow elves.

entities.name: Einir
entities.description: The elvish gods of Kaldheim replaced by the Skoti.

entities.name: Harald
entities.description: An elf who united the warring clans of Skemfar and named himself king.

entities.name: Locthwain elves
entities.description: The noble elves of the court of Locthwain.

entities.name: Queen Ayara
entities.description: The ancient elf who rules the court of Locthwain.

entities.name: Lorwyn Elves
entities.description: The dominant supremacist elves of Lorwyn who call themselves the Blessed Nation.

entities.name: Eyeblights
entities.description: Creatures judged ugly by elvish standards and hunted by the Lorwyn elves.

entities.name: Shadowmoor Elves
entities.description: The elves of Shadowmoor who preserve beauty in safeholds.

entities.name: Viridian Elves
entities.description: Elves of Mirrodin drawn from another world by Memnarch, living in the Tangle.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Mirrodin's mad guardian who drew the elves there.

entities.name: Resurgents
entities.description: Elves who survived the Vanishing and became militant eco-terrorists.

entities.name: Phyrexian Elves
entities.description: Elves compleated by glistening oil and part of the Vicious Swarm.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: The de facto Phyrexian leader of the Tangle region.

entities.name: Erstwhile
entities.description: Elvish aristocrats entombed in the Undercity and reanimated by the Golgari.

entities.name: Golgari
entities.description: The Ravnican guild that reanimated the Erstwhile and took in cast-out Silhana.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of the Silhana elves.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: The Ravnican guild joined by the surviving Simic elves.

entities.name: Devkarin Elves
entities.description: The dark elves of Ravnica presided over by a Matka.

entities.name: Silhana Elves
entities.description: Ravnican elves in the Selesnya Conclave.

entities.name: Joraga Nation
entities.description: A Zendikari elf nation nearly eliminated by the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Speaker Nen
entities.description: The leader of the Joraga Nation.

entities.name: Mul Daya Nation
entities.description: A secretive Zendikari elf nation wiped out by the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Hazzan
entities.description: The living leader of the Mul Daya.

entities.name: Tajuru Nation
entities.description: The largest and most prominent Zendikari elf faction.

entities.name: Sutina
entities.description: The Speaker of the Tajuru who died in the tentacles of Kozilek.

entities.name: Kazandu Splinter
entities.description: A faction that broke from the Tajuru, refusing to accept Sutina.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi Titan whose tentacles killed Sutina.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The titans and brood that nearly wiped out Zendikari elf nations.

entities.name: Kor Empire
entities.description: The empire that subjugates the elves of Zendikar in the Echoverse.

entities.name: Echoverse
entities.description: An alternate reality where Zendikar's elves are subjugated.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane where elves were driven to extinction.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: The Avishkari authority that granted elves judicial autonomy.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion that compleated many elves and diminished Lorwyn's elven order.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion of Dominaria that displaced Yavimaya and created Gaea's Skyfolk.

events.summary: Yawgmoth turns the Creeping Mold of Argoth into a plague that eats away the elves.
events.quote: Yawgmoth turned the Creeping Mold of Argoth into a virulent plague that ate away the elves there.

events.summary: Yawgmoth kidnaps the priestess Elyssendril and her healers and extorts the elves.
events.quote: When the elves paid, he delivered only sweetened water and 12 dead healers to them.

events.summary: Elyssendril is sent as a delegate to Halcyon against Yawgmoth.
events.quote: Elyssendril survived and was later part of the delegates sent to Halcyon on behalf of the Thran Alliance against Yawgmoth.

events.summary: Harbin is helped by an Argothian elf and tells Urza of the island.
events.quote: When, millennia later, Harbin stumbled upon Argoth, he was helped by an Argothian elf.

events.summary: Urza activates the Golgothian Sylex and destroys Argoth and its elves.
events.quote: ultimately they were all destroyed when Urza activated the Golgothian Sylex

events.summary: Fyndhorn is swallowed by the sea and refugees are led to Yavimaya.
events.quote: Fyndhorn was swallowed by the sea

events.summary: Part of Yavimaya is displaced to Urborg during the Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: During the third phase of the Phyrexian Invasion, part of Yavimaya was displaced to Urborg.

events.summary: The enraged spirit of Multani casts out the Yavimayan elves.
events.quote: Cast out by the enraged spirit of Multani

events.summary: The Yavimayan exiles under Meria join the Coalition.
events.quote: they joined The Coalition against the Second Phyrexian Invasion

events.summary: The black elves poison Red Donald, who recovers.
events.quote: They managed to poison him, but he recovered.

events.summary: The Skyshroud elves take up worship of Freyalise after the forest planeshifts to Keld.
events.quote: where the elves took up the worship of Freyalise

events.summary: The Havenwood elves inadvertently create the thallids, which cause their extinction.
events.quote: inadvertently creating the monstrous thallids

events.summary: The Mirari's mana waves mutate many Wirewood elves.
events.quote: When the Mirari started spreading its mana waves over the continent, many of the elves mutated

events.summary: Harald unites the warring clans of Skemfar and names himself king.
events.quote: Harald united the warring clans and named himself king

events.summary: The leaders of the Einir are imprisoned inside trees after the gods are replaced.
events.quote: After their defeat, the leaders of the elvish Einir were imprisoned inside trees

events.summary: Elves are driven to extinction on Innistrad.
events.quote: but were driven to extinction

events.summary: Many Lorwyn elves fall out of favor after the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: they fell out of favor after the New Phyrexian Invasion

events.summary: Memnarch draws the Viridian elves to Mirrodin from another world.
events.quote: by Mirrodin's mad guardian, Memnarch

events.summary: Survivors of the Vanishing organize as the Resurgents.
events.quote: Many of those who survived the Vanishing called themselves the Resurgents

events.summary: Many elves are compleated and join the Vicious Swarm.
events.quote: many elves have been compleated by the glistening oil and become a part of the Phyrexian faction, the Vicious Swarm

events.summary: The Golgari unearth the Erstwhile's coffins and reanimate them.
events.quote: The Golgari have unearthed their coffins and reanimated them as part of the Swarm.

events.summary: The Eldrazi nearly eliminate the Joraga.
events.quote: the Joraga were nearly eliminated

events.summary: Most of the Mul Daya are wiped out by the Eldrazi.
events.quote: most of the Mul Daya were wiped out by the Eldrazi

events.summary: Sutina dies in the tentacles of Kozilek.
events.quote: Before the creature died in the tentacles of Kozilek

events.summary: The Kazandu Splinter breaks off from the Tajuru, refusing to see Sutina as their leader.
events.quote: they broke off from the nation, refusing to see Speaker Sutina as their leader

relations.quote: Yawgmoth turned the Creeping Mold of Argoth into a virulent plague that ate away the elves there.
